mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agreements (user_id, terms_agreed_at, privacy_agreed_at, email_notification, updates_agreed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{termsAgreedAt}, #{privacyAgreedAt}, #{emailNotification}, #{updatesAgreedAt})

INSERT INTO user_agreements (user_id, email_notification, updates_agreed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{emailNotification}, #{updatesAgreedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE email_notification = VALUES(email_notification), updates_agreed_at = VALUES(updates_agreed_at)
